title: fix(console): a user with no personal language gets their browser's language when the app ships it, else the app default
body:
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X5Dqh7NEiHRd1ETkL7pny2w)_ Fixes #33985 Clause-②: no Metadata-protocol: none ## 维护者速读 - 改了什么：没有设置个人语言的用户打开 Console 时，浏览器语言在应用的支持列表里就用浏览器语言；不在列表里才用应用默认语言。个人语言（`sys_user.locale`）和在本设备上手动选的语言仍然优先。 - 为什么改：18.5.0 把应用默认语言放在浏览器语言之前，而应用总有默认语言，结果中文浏览器在「默认英文、也支持中文」的应用里一律看到英文（hotclm、duly、hotcrm 三家实测）。你裁定 B「浏览器语言受支持就优先」。 - 风险与回滚：只改 Console 前端两处语言请求头的取值，不改服务端和协议；回滚即 revert 本 PR。设备上已缓存的语言种子会在下次启动时被刷新为新答案。 - 先看：`ui/apps/console/src/languageSeed.ts` 的 `pickPreferredLocale`（匹配规则：走服务端同一条 `resolveLocaleAmong` 阶梯，精确、大小写不敏感、平台别名 `ja`→`ja-JP`、基础语言 `en-US`→`en`、变体 `es-MX`→`es-ES`、`zh`→`zh-CN`）；`LocalizationFetchProvider.tsx` 的取值改名处。 - 两分钟验证：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/src/languageSeed.test.ts` 应全绿，其中「zh-CN 浏览器 + 支持 en/zh-CN + 默认 en → zh-CN」与「fr 浏览器 → en」两条即裁决的钉子。 - 需要你做的：无，席位落地。 ## What changes For a signed-in user with no personal language, the Console's language is now the user's own `sys_user.locale`, else the browser's language when the app lists it in discovery `locale.supported`, else the app's declared default (discovery `locale.default`), else `en`. This carries out ruling 6915665005 on #33985 (letter B, maintainer 「B 浏览器语言受支持就优先」), unchanged. - `ui/apps/console/src/languageSeed.ts`: `loadAppDefaultLocale` becomes `loadPreferredLocale`, which reads discovery `locale.default` and `locale.supported` through the console's one shared discovery request and states `pickPreferredLocale(navigator.language, supported, default)` as the `Accept-Language` of the boot's `/api/v1/auth/me/localization` read. `startedAppDefaultLocale` and the test seam are renamed to match. The module docblock's #33231 section is rewritten to the ruling. - `pickPreferredLocale` (new, exported for the tests): the browser's top tag (`navigator.language`) is matched against `locale.supported` through `resolveLocaleAmong` (`@objectstack/spec/system`), the server's own `Accept-Language` ladder: exact, case-insensitive, platform table aliases (`ja` → `ja-JP`, `zh-TW` → `zh-Hant`), base language (`en-US` → `en`), variant (`es-MX` → `es-ES`, `zh` → `zh-CN`); no match ⇒ the app default. The answer is the app's own spelling of the entry. - `ui/apps/console/src/LocalizationFetchProvider.tsx`: the every-boot read states the same value (`startedPreferredLocale`), so the seed read and this read still share one request on a first visit. Unchanged: an explicit device choice is stated as before; with discovery answering nothing, the browser's own header goes out. - No server, spec or protocol change; `locale.supported` was already served. The ruling's finding 3 (the organization's Localization setting never reaches the Console's language, because the Console always states a language and the server's deployment-default rung never answers) is not in this PR, per the ruling. Confirmed from the code (discovery `locale.default` is the i18n service's `getDefaultLocale()`, the app's `i18n.defaultLocale`) and filed as #34392. ## Tests - `languageSeed.test.ts`: the #33231 block is rewritten per the ruling's "After the ruling". Rendered boot pins (seed → `preloadBootstrapLocale` → `I18nProvider` probe of `common.cancel` and ``): a `zh-CN` browser with `supported: ['en','zh-CN']` and default `en` gets `zh-CN`; CONTROL, an `fr` browser on the same app gets `en`; the #33231 pin, rewritten to the case it still owns: an `en-US` browser on a `zh-CN`-only app gets `zh-CN`; an `en-US` browser on a `zh-CN` app that also ships `en` gets `en` (the ruling's stated cost of B); a personal locale still outranks both; with no locale block served the browser's own header goes. Plus unit pins of `pickPreferredLocale`. - `LocalizationFetchProvider.test.tsx`: the read states a supported browser language (`zh-CN` on an `en`-default app), and states the app default for an unsupported one (`fr` on a `zh-CN` app). - `__tests__/localizationBootDedup.test.tsx`: the one-request pin now runs on the browser-language path (both reads state `zh-CN`, one localization request).
Test run and ablation at b8ce00c8 - `cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/src/languageSeed.test.ts apps/console/src/LocalizationFetchProvider.test.tsx apps/console/src/__tests__/localizationBootDedup.test.tsx` (under `os-verify-lock.sh`, after the `@object-ui/console^...` closure build): `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 47 passed (47)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. - Ablation (one, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, fix committed first): `languageSeed.ts` anchor `const tag = typeof browserTag === 'string' ? browserTag.trim().toLowerCase() : '';` replaced by `const tag = '';` (anchor x1 -> x0, blob `210683d22911` -> `25f7a6f1e9b3`), which is the 18.5.0 behaviour (app default always). Same three files: `Tests 6 failed | 41 passed (47)`; red: the zh-CN browser pin, the en-US-to-en pin, both `pickPreferredLocale` match pins, the provider's supported-browser pin, the one-request pin. The CONTROL (`fr` → `en`) and the unsupported-language pins stayed green, as they should. Restored: blob == HEAD (`210683d22911`), `git diff HEAD` empty.
## Acceptance notes - Matching rule: the ruling says "the browser's language when the app lists it". This PR reads it as follows: the browser's top tag (`navigator.language`) is matched against `locale.supported` through `resolveLocaleAmong` (`@objectstack/spec/system`), the server's own `Accept-Language` ladder: exact, case-insensitive, platform table aliases (`ja` → `ja-JP`, `zh-TW` → `zh-Hant`), base language (`en-US` → `en`), variant (`es-MX` → `es-ES`, `zh` → `zh-CN`); no match ⇒ the app default. Changed in fix round 1 (L1 REWORK 6917299693) from a two-step matcher, so `ja`, `zh-TW` and `es-MX` browsers get the language the app ships. - Out of scope, filed: #34392 (finding 3 of the ruling record). ## Verification
Local gates at b8ce00c8 (38 derived + console type-check, all exit 0) - `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check` :: exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -b tsconfig.node.json --force`, after the closure build; compiles the test files). - `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 38 families; all 38 run, each exit 0; `--ran` reconciliation: `38 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 38 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 38 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`. Families: check-adr-0087-registration (base + self-test), check-changeset-no-major, check-closing-keyword-parity (+ self-test), check-comment-mask-corpus, check-empty-changeset (base + self-test), check-sdui-manifest (+ self-test), snapshot-next, check-governed-queue-guard, release-rehearsal-clone, release-pending-publish self-tests, `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`, spec check:duration-unit-keys, check:adr-anchors, check:changeset-gate-self-tests, check:closed-ceremony-text, check:cross-package-test-inputs, check:dispatcher-error-vocabulary, check:driver-memory-census, check:engine-double-contract, check:error-status-conformance, check:gitlink-declared, check:nul-bytes, check:published-files, check:query-options-erasure, check:refd-timer-probe, check:registry-log-declared, check:rest-log-spy-declared, check:test-source-alias, check:tier-file-adoption, check:type-check-coverage, check:type-check-debt, check:undeclared-dep-imports, check:watch-hint-literal, check:where-matcher. - Not run locally (CI-owned): the whole console vitest project, `pnpm lint`, `test:repo`, and the families outside the derivation. Full dogfood not owed (no `!` in the title, no `(narrowing)` arm).
